Print an ordination result

Source: R/ord_utils.r
print.ecodive_ord.Rd

Prints the coordinates, then one line on the axes and the names of the other attributes, rather than every attribute in full (such as pca()'s loadings).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ecodive_ord'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An ordination result, from dist_ord(), count_ord(), pcoa(), pca(), rpca(), rpca_phylo(), rda(), cca(), ca(), lda(), plsda(), oplsda(), dbrda(), capscale(), mds(), nmds(), isomap(), tsne(), umap(), or procrustes().

...

Passed on to print() for the matrix of coordinates.

Value

x, invisibly.
